register_title: Retrospect Phase C — Express Restricted Candidate Provenance Register
notice: CONFIDENTIAL RESEARCH ARTIFACT — FOR SANITIZATION REVIEW AND EVALUATION INTEGRITY ONLY. NEVER EXPOSE TO QUERY AUTHORS.

summary.protocol_invariant: Context Card synthesis requires an exact match against this register. Any Context Card misrepresenting a Tier 2 or Tier 3 candidate as Tier 1 will be rejected by the audit gate.

candidates.evidence: Authored by Wes in 2017 ('call callback once on listen error'). Predecessor exists at lib/application.js:L608. Verified in test/app.listen.js ('should call callback only once on error').
candidates.uncertainty_assessment: Low historical uncertainty regarding the bug itself, but High provenance uncertainty regarding user dialogue. No external GitHub issue was filed or linked in the commit. Context Card must be synthesized from test suite behavior and commit notes.
candidates.sanitization_risk: Medium. Risk of using 'listen' or 'server' as clues. Must describe HTTP startup error callbacks generically.

candidates.sanitization_risk: High. The words 'render' and 'application' appear naturally in issue titles and must be sanitized to 'template evaluation' and 'framework instance'.
